item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las dbang rgyud me ri 'khyil ba
item.coloph: ye shes gsas mkhar srid pa rab 'byams kyi rgyud las/ dbang rgyud me ri 'khyil pa zhes bya ba/ gshen gsang ba 'dus pa'i gtan la phab ste/ dbal chen po stag la me 'bar gyis rgyad la byin gyis brlabs shing bskur ba'o/ des lha klu mi gsum snang mdog bzhi'i rgyud la byin gyis brlabs shing bskul ba'o/ des dmu gshen dran pa nam mkha'i rgyud la byin gyis brlabs cing bskur ba'o/ des rje blon 'bang gsum ra sangs khod ram dang bzhi'i rgyud la byin gyis brlabs cing bskur ba'o/ dbang gi brgyud pa'i rim pa bstan pa'o/ gsang ba'i man ngag gsang la spyad pa'o/ u ya/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgyargya//
